summary: Implemented the 630 Lambda transform feature. Added `Lambda` (array) in monai/transforms/utility/array.py, which applies a user callable and raises TypeError for non-callables. Added `Lambdad` (dictionary) in monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py, which applies one callable or a per-key sequence of callables to the listed keys, copying the input dict. Added the LambdaD/LambdaDict aliases. Added tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py. Nothing was run or committed, per the instructions, so the new tests are unverified. Docs are covered by docstrings; there is no utility docs page and the CHANGELOG is untouched.
